*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: similarity_score.py
+import math
+import os
+from typing import Iterable, Sequence
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", "text-embedding-3-small")
+OPENAI_API_KEY = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+OPENAI_API_BASE = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_BASE", "https://api.openai.com/v1")
+
+
+def _embed_text(text: str) -> Sequence[float]:
+    if not OPENAI_API_KEY:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    response = requests.post(
+        f"{OPENAI_API_BASE.rstrip('/')}/embeddings",
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENAI_API_KEY}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={"model": OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL, "input": text},
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    return data["data"][0]["embedding"]
+
+
+def _cosine_similarity(a: Iterable[float], b: Iterable[float]) -> float:
+    a_list = list(a)
+    b_list = list(b)
+    if len(a_list) != len(b_list):
+        raise ValueError("Embeddings must have the same dimensionality")
+    dot = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a_list, b_list))
+    norm_a = math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in a_list))
+    norm_b = math.sqrt(sum(y * y for y in b_list))
+    if norm_a == 0.0 or norm_b == 0.0:
+        raise ValueError("Embeddings must be non-zero vectors")
+    return dot / (norm_a * norm_b)
+
+
+def similarity_score(text_a: str, text_b: str) -> float:
+    embedding_a = _embed_text(text_a)
+    embedding_b = _embed_text(text_b)
+    return _cosine_similarity(embedding_a, embedding_b)
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: embed_text.py
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+DEFAULT_MODEL = "text-embedding-3-small"
+
+
+def _client() -> OpenAI:
+    return OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+
+
+def embed_text(text: str, model: str = DEFAULT_MODEL) -> List[float]:
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("text must be a string")
+    if not text.strip():
+        raise ValueError("text must not be empty")
+    response = _client().embeddings.create(model=model, input=text)
+    return list(response.data[0].embedding)
+
+
+def main(text: str, model: str = DEFAULT_MODEL) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    embedding = embed_text(text, model=model)
+    return {"model": model, "embedding": embedding}
+
*** End Patch
